name: Section
description: Contains other components; holds the printed heading, including any section number.

name: Question
description: Requests one or more answers; has variables recording them.

name: Introduction
description: Opening text that introduces the questionnaire or a section.

name: Instruction
description: Printed directions telling the respondent how to answer.

name: Definition
description: Printed explanation of a term used in the questionnaire.

name: Interviewer Script
description: Text an interviewer reads aloud or follows.

name: Question Group
description: Holds blocks that belong together but have no printed heading: a battery, a definition with its question, a question with its follow-up. Has no text.
